equality: GO instruction is the exact CG instruction prefix. Output formats are identical. CG adds only retrieval guidance.
shared_requirements: Every record first submitted in calendar 2020 UTC
Current categories include cs.LG, including crosslists
Each direct named replacement, update, correction, merger result or mistaken-submission redirect
Exclude merely related, independently equivalent and unnamed forthcoming works
Cutoff is source last listed submission timestamp, not a withdrawal-event date
Latest successor submission at or before cutoff; all latest-time ties
Omit relations with no eligible successor version
Stop for source submission drift after anchor
Six specified columns and source/target/version sorting

rule_preservation.new_aliases: Only v14 to integer 14 and the same four UTC-format aliases for each newly evidenced timestamp. No title, identity or relation aliases.
rule_preservation.ties: All latest-time ties remain required by both public variants and both programs. Actual selected histories contain no ties, so the inherited two-field row key is adequate for this oracle.

publisher_application: Both variants request catalogue records, catalogue submission histories and an integer successor version. The explicit Wiley relation is preserved but supplies no supported distinct catalogue successor version after complete relevant identity queries. It is not silently called unrelated, mapped to the source itself, or assigned an invented publisher version. This applies the existing output domain and no-eligible-version requirement, without adding a public condition.
empty_comment_application: Both variants refer to the current notice. Official documentation identifies the withdrawal reason as the Comments field. Empty Comments cannot contain a named successor notice; this does not assert active status.
public_leakage: Public files contain only instruction and output_format. They contain no target website name, answer IDs, author hints, expected row count, oracle, source manifest or private review evidence.
execution: String/schema equality and rule-preservation checks performed in JavaScript. Independent Python repeats public equality checks when executed by controller. No solver or admission execution occurred.
